card_line: Mars rules you both. Bold meets bold.
s21_body: You both go after what you want. The drive matches, just aim it at the same goal and not at each other.
One balances the room, the other keeps it. You both love beauty, comfort and a well planned evening.

card_line: Mercury rules you both. Talk never runs dry.
s21_body: You both live in your heads in the best way. Expect long conversations and very good texts.

card_line: Jupiter rules you both. Big dreams, shared.
s21_body: You both believe in more: more adventure, more meaning, more possibility. Dream big together.

card_line: Saturn rules you both. You play the long game.
s21_body: You both take commitment seriously and do not waste time. Slow to start, very hard to break.
